sources.games: 1816 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 48.9%, soft support (STRATZ pos4, 8014 games). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py hoodwink.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata item_id 267 (Spirit Vessel) and 206 (Rod of Atos), current patch, fetched 2026-11-07.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Spirit Vessel
rules.basis: Valve /datafeed/itemdata Spirit Vessel (fetched 2026-11-07): Soul Release on an enemy cuts its health restoration by 70% and drains 4% of its current health per second for 8 s (10 s cooldown, 750 cast range, charges from hero deaths within 1500). High-rank Hoodwinks against Huskar, Lifestealer, Oracle, Necrophos or Alchemist: Spirit Vessel in 12% of 265 games (3% otherwise), won 69% against 50%. Sharpshooter (Valve) deals up to 600/975/1350 damage to one hero, Bushwhack 90-360 over its stun.

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} cuts their health restoration by 70% for 8 s, so Bushwhack and Sharpshooter damage is not healed back
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} на 8 с знижує їхнє відновлення здоров'я на 70%, тож шкода від Bushwhack і Sharpshooter не відновиться

rules.name: Rod of Atos
rules.basis: Valve /datafeed/itemdata Rod of Atos (item 206, fetched 2026-11-07): Cripple roots the target for 2 s from 1100 range (18 s cooldown; +275 health, +12 intelligence). A rooted hero cannot move or use movement spells (Blink, Ball Lightning), the player review of 2026-11-07. High-rank Hoodwinks against an escape hero: Rod of Atos in 27% of 826 games (16% otherwise), won 52% against 47%.

reason.en: {enemy} gets away with {spell}: {item} roots them for 2 s from 1100 range, so they cannot walk or blink out of Bushwhack and Sharpshooter
reason.uk: {enemy} тікає через {spell}: {item} з відстані 1100 приковує його до місця на 2 с, тож він не втече ні пішки, ні блінком від Bushwhack і Sharpshooter

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 99% (0), magic_wand 89% (9), ring_of_basilius 71% (10), urn_of_shadows 46% (11), arcane_boots 69% (13), essence_distiller 38% (16), vitality_booster 32% (20), rod_of_atos 23% (20), staff_of_wizardry 72% (21), great_famango 25% (23), aghanims_shard 37% (25), glimmer_cape 27% (26), force_staff 39% (26), cyclone 22% (28), blink 40% (28), mystic_staff 20% (41). Reviewed: Vitality Booster (a part, 32% at 20 min) dropped; Rod of Atos (23% at 20 min) is not in the build. STRATZ pos4 (8014 games) has only Essence Distiller 14 min 55% (won 50%).
